passive.name: Phenomenal Evil Power
passive.description: Veigar is the greatest Evil to ever strike at the hearts of Runeterra - and he's only getting bigger! Striking an enemy Champion with a spell or scoring a takedown grants Veigar permanently increased Ability Power.

primaryAbilities.name: Baleful Strike
primaryAbilities.description: Veigar unleashes a bolt of dark energy that deals magic damage to the first two enemies hit. Units killed by this bolt grant Veigar some ability power permanently.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Veigar unleashes a bolt of dark energy, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to the first two enemies hit.

If Veigar kills an enemy with this Ability, he gains {{ spell.veigarpassive:dqkillstacks }} stack of Phenomenal Evil. Large minions and large monsters grant {{ spell.veigarpassive:dqkillstackslarge }} stacks instead.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Dark Matter
primaryAbilities.description: Veigar calls a great mass of dark matter to fall from the sky to the target location, dealing magic damage when it lands. Stacks of Phenomenal Evil reduce Dark Matter's cooldown.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Veigar summons dark matter from the sky, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage.

Every {{ spell.veigarpassive:pstacksperdarkmattercdr }} stacks of Phenomenal Evil reduce this Ability's Cooldown by {{ spell.veigarpassive:darkmattercdrincrement*100 }}%.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Event Horizon
primaryAbilities.description: Veigar twists the edges of space, creating a cage that Stuns enemies that pass through.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Veigar twists the edges of space, creating a cage that <status>Stuns</status> enemies that pass through for {{ stunduration }} seconds. The cage lasts for 3 seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Primordial Burst
primaryAbilities.description: Blasts target enemy champion, dealing a large amount of magic damage, increasing based on the target's missing health.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Veigar blasts an enemy champion with primal magic to deal between <magicDamage>{{ mindamage }} and {{ maxdamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>, increasing with the target's missing Health. Damage is maximized against enemies below 33% Health.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

allSpellRecords.name: Baleful Strike
allSpellRecords.summary: Veigar unleashes a bolt of dark energy that deals magic damage to the first two enemies hit. Units killed by this bolt grant Veigar some ability power permanently.
allSpellRecords.tooltipWithSymbolicValues:
Veigar unleashes a bolt of dark energy, dealing [80 / 120 / 160 / 200 / 240 + (0.5 / 0.55 / 0.6 / 0.65 / 0.7) × AP] magic damage to the first two enemies hit.

If Veigar kills an enemy with this Ability, he gains @Spell.VeigarPassive:dQKillStacks@ stack of Phenomenal Evil. Large minions and large monsters grant @Spell.VeigarPassive:dQKillStacksLarge@ stacks instead.

allSpellRecords.name: Phenomenal Evil Power
allSpellRecords.summary: Veigar is the greatest Evil to ever strike at the hearts of Runeterra - and he's only getting bigger! Striking an enemy Champion with a spell or scoring a takedown grants Veigar permanently increased Ability Power.
allSpellRecords.tooltipWithSymbolicValues:
Veigar's Abilities grant him [1] stack of Phenomenal Evil when they strike enemy champions. Takedowns on champions grant an additional [5] stacks.

Each stack of Phenomenal Evil grants Veigar [1] Ability Power.

allSpellRecords.name: Event Horizon
allSpellRecords.summary: Veigar twists the edges of space, creating a cage that Stuns enemies that pass through.
allSpellRecords.tooltipWithSymbolicValues: Veigar twists the edges of space, creating a cage that Stuns enemies that pass through for [1.5 / 1.75 / 2 / 2.25 / 2.5] seconds. The cage lasts for 3 seconds.

allSpellRecords.name: Dark Matter
allSpellRecords.summary: Veigar calls a great mass of dark matter to fall from the sky to the target location, dealing magic damage when it lands. Stacks of Phenomenal Evil reduce Dark Matter's cooldown.
allSpellRecords.tooltipWithSymbolicValues:
Veigar summons dark matter from the sky, dealing [85 / 140 / 195 / 250 / 305 + (0.7 / 0.8 / 0.9 / 1 / 1.1) × AP] magic damage.

Every @Spell.VeigarPassive:PStacksPerDarkMatterCDR@ stacks of Phenomenal Evil reduce this Ability's Cooldown by @Spell.VeigarPassive:DarkMatterCDRIncrement*100@%.

allSpellRecords.name: Primordial Burst
allSpellRecords.summary: Blasts target enemy champion, dealing a large amount of magic damage, increasing based on the target's missing health.
allSpellRecords.tooltipWithSymbolicValues: Veigar blasts an enemy champion with primal magic to deal between [175 / 250 / 325 + (0.65 / 0.7 / 0.75) × AP] and [(175 / 250 / 325 + (0.65 / 0.7 / 0.75) × AP) × (2)] magic damage, increasing with the target's missing Health. Damage is maximized against enemies below 33% Health.
